page.title: Skill audit review
page.heroNote: Accept, reject, or edit each fix.
page.hostsHint: Platform-specific rules were checked for these hosts only.
page.sideFoot: Your decisions stay in this browser. Accepted and edited fixes reach the agent, a rejected one as a fix not to propose again (with its comment as the reason), and a comment on an undecided fix as a question.
page.statusIdle: Decide each fix; the instruction below updates as you go.
page.copied: Instruction copied. Paste it into the agent chat.
page.copyFailed: Clipboard unavailable. Copy the selected instruction and paste it into the agent chat.
page.nothingAccepted: Nothing to export yet: accept, edit, or reject a fix, or ask a question in a comment.
page.exportHint: Copy your decisions and questions into the agent chat.
page.exportNote: A fix you did not decide on goes in only with a comment, as your question; the agent answers it and leaves the fix alone. A rejected fix goes in as one not to apply or propose again, with its comment as the reason.
page.handEdited: Edited by hand: decisions you make now do not reach this text.
page.commentHint: Optional note or question for the agent
page.priorReason: Rejected by the reviewer in an earlier round
page.placeholders: Placeholders to fill in (use Edit; Accept is off until then)
page.storageBlocked: Browser storage is blocked: marks and comments work but are lost when the page reloads.
page.navRefs: Show or hide the findings this edit also fixes
page.resetConfirm: Reset every decision, edit, and comment on this page? This cannot be undone.
page.resetKeeps: Rejections from an earlier round stay rejected.
page.rejectFindingHint: Why the finding is wrong (goes to the agent)
page.editDraft: Draft · not included in the instruction yet
page.editReady: Save the change or choose Accept: both use the entered text.
page.savedManual: Change saved. The instruction was edited by hand: rebuild it from decisions to include the change.
page.saved: Change saved and included in the agent instruction. Accept confirms this revised text.
page.placeholderNote: Choose Edit, fill in the placeholders, then Save change: {s}
page.acceptTitle: Accepts the current revised text. Fill in any placeholders through Edit first.
